TraceScope: Opt-in XAML callbacks, input delivery, dispatcher queue delay, GC counts and managed memory; names and paths omitted. Trace includes whole app process; process.csv covers only capture interval.
CPUInterpretation: Total process CPU seconds; multicore CPU time can exceed wall time
RetainedMemoryInterpretation: End private bytes/working set without forced GC; does not prove a leak
SuggestedManualScenarios: Scroll slowly, rapidly, jump to beginning/end
Type exact/partial/Unicode/wildcard/no-result queries; rapidly replace query
Navigate away during search and enumerate
Repeat 20 navigation cycles; wait 10 seconds idle; sample memory
Select visible rows with pointer and keyboard while loading
